`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I haven't run it or any tests.

The response uses `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)`, so it comes back as `application/problem+json`. That follows the project's convention for API errors. Before this change, a missing invoice made the handler crash with an `AttributeError` on `None.__dict__`.

Nothing from this task seemed worth saving to memory. The problem+json convention was already recorded and held up.
